description: Maps any US county or independent city into Crosodo's universal 4-Box municipal permit framework across 4 government departments: (1) Food & Kitchen Authority, (2) Zoning & Home Address Use, (3) Business Entity & Local License, and (4) Sales Tax, Cap & Channels. Each box reports an explicit disposition (EXEMPT_BY_STATUTE, SELF_COMPLY, FILING_REQUIRED, CONDITIONAL_ON_ANSWERS, UNVERIFIED_FALLBACK), fees, official .gov links, and recommended filing order. Works anonymously (pass state + county or fips) or merges saved checkmarks when signed in. Cottage food laws change. This summary is generated from Crosodo's hand-maintained dataset — it is not legal advice. Verify with your county before selling.

county.description: County or independent city name/slug (e.g. Fairfax County or fairfax)

fips.description: Optional 5-digit county/city FIPS instead of state + county

level.description: Vertical ladder rung 1..4 (1=Hobby, 2=Cottage Food [default], 3=Inspected Home Kitchen, 4=Commercial)

state.description: 2-letter USPS state abbrev (e.g. VA, CA, TX) or state name/slug

name: get_four_box_checklist
title: 4-Box municipal permit checklist for any US county
